resolvedIssues.draftText: 四例患者的延长随访显示部分缓解持久，但复发、进展和死亡仍突出。
resolvedIssues.sourceQuote: Of the four patients, one maintained stringent complete response for 15 months.
resolvedIssues.reason: “部分缓解”也是partial response（PR）的固定临床术语；该句可能将持久缓解归于PR，而公开摘要明确归于一例严格完全缓解。
resolvedIssues.suggestedReplacement: 一例严格完全缓解持续较久，但其余患者复发、进展并死亡。
resolvedIssues.resolution: Independently reread the current full final translation and every quicklook field against the fixed English title and abstract; corrected comparison/category wording now matches the source.
